title: India beat New Zealand by 22 runs in the fifth ODI at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui (Sun 15 Nov 2026) to win the five-match series 3-1: India 209 all out batting first (Ishan Kishan, Axar Patel 46 each), NZ 187 all out (Arshdeep Singh 3-30); two days earlier at the same ground India were 89 all out and lost by 244 runs; third ODI in Hamilton washed out; ends NZ's run of 11 straight home bilateral ODI series wins, their first home ODI series defeat since India in 2019; India also won the T20Is 3-2; two Tests follow: Basin Reserve, Wellington, 19-23 Nov and Hagley Oval, Christchurch, 27 Nov-1 Dec, 3:30 am IST, Sony Sports Network/Sony LIV.
headline: Out for 89 Friday, India Defend 209 to Win NZ Series 3-1
